machineDescription: Existing M4 MacBook Air / 16 GB development machine; chip query denied in this restricted execution environment.
limitations: Not an independently annotated segmentation accuracy benchmark. IoU is agreement between model predictions.
Runs were sequential on a shared fanless desktop; timing and memory are observations, not controlled guarantees.
Peak process RSS is not total unified-memory pressure; available headroom is sampled.
This CPU evaluation does not validate a new GPU, operating system, or inference engine in Sculpt.
